name: read_file
description: Reads the contents of a file from the local filesystem.

name: write_file
description: Writes content to a specified file path, creating it if it doesn't exist.

name: run_go_command
description: Executes a Go command in the current terminal context (e.g., go build, go test).

name: list_directory
description: Lists files and directories in a given path.

name: get_package_info
description: Retrieves information about a specific Go module or package version.
